title: Mcp Sampling
motto: Most MCP servers are dumb executors: take arguments, run code, return content. Sampling lets a server flip direction: it asks the client's LLM to make a decision. This enables server-hosted agent loops without the server owning any model credentials. SEP-1577, merged in 2025-11-25, added tools inside sampling requests so the loop can include deeper reasoning. Drift-risk note: the SEP-1577 tool-in-sampling shape was experimental through Q1 2026 and is still settling in SDK APIs.

steps.title: The problem
cards: A useful MCP server for a code-summarization workflow needs to: walk a file tree, pick which files to read, synthesize a summary, and return. Where does the LLM reasoning happen?
Option A: the server calls its own LLM. Needs an API key, bills server-side, is expensive per user.
Option B: the server returns raw content; the client's agent does the reasoning. Works but moves server logic into the client prompt, which is fragile.
